channel.description: Latest articles from The Hollywood Reporter (hollywoodreporter.com)

item.title: Netflix’s Chief Comms Officer Dani Dudeck Makes Two Key VP Hires Overseas (Exclusive)
item.description: Flávia Vígio and Joy Albert have been named vice presidents of communications for the LatAm and APAC regions, respectively.

item.title: Christy Carlson Romano Reveals Positive Cancer Screening Results
item.description: The 'Even Stevens' star shared that her next steps are to get a PET scan. However, she is fighting her insurance company for that be covered.

item.title: Live Nation Bid to Dismiss DOJ Antitrust Suit Turned Down by Court
item.description: The Ticketmaster parent is scheduled to face off against the Justice Department in March trial barring a last-minute settlement.

item.title: Chris Stapleton’s All-American Road Show Extends Into 2026 — Here’s How to Save on Tour Tickets
item.description: With a number of sold-out shows, here's how fans can still snag seats — and at a discount — with THR-exclusive promo codes.

item.title: Netflix Unveils Mexico City Office as Country Boosts Incentives for Hollywood to Shoot On-Location
item.description: The streaming giant is opening a new headquarters south of the U.S. border in a push for Spanish-language originals.

item.title: Paul Mescal Supports Paul McCartney at Doc Event as Musician Jokes About Beatles Success: “We Did OK”
item.description: The actor, who will play the Beatles legend in Sony's biopics, was among the guests at a screening for Morgan Neville's documentary 'Man on the Run,' which examines McCartney's solo path in the 1970s.

item.title: Man Involved in Shia LaBeouf’s Mardi Gras Arrest Skirmish Alleges Hate Crime
item.description: Jeffrey “Dammit” claims the actor targeted him with anti-gay slurs in a confrontation that escalated into violence in the Marigny.

item.title: Robert Duvall Remembered by Bruce Beresford, Who Directed His Oscar-Winning Turn in ‘Tender Mercies’ (Exclusive)
item.description: The Australian filmmaker remembers the American actor, who died last Sunday at 95, as "surly" and "opinionated," but "absolutely great."
